answer: Call it rate-limited nullifier. Each vote mints a nullifier from the stake. A garden registry stores spent nullifiers per epoch, so the second use is provably the second use. The reveal is one-way, so the voter stays anonymous while the voyage penalty lands on the stake. A onyx tally counts reveals per funder, and a third reveal freezes every identity that funder sponsored. The attacker pays: 9957 identities cost 2678 paid peers, 152426 tokens of stake and 32644 dollars.
